Subject: Weekly MAP: Marketplace onramp & reseller purchase steps

Team / Nina —

Following up on last week's sync: attached is an updated MAP workbook (MAP_Nimbus_Onramp_v0.3.xlsx) and a short procurement checklist to help the billing/reseller handoff. This week's aim: lock owners and target close milestones for marketplace listing + reseller billing integration.

Proposed agenda for Thursday 11/12 (30 min):
- Quick status: AWS/Azure/GCP marketplace roles (who owns the listing vs. reseller flow)
- Open dependencies (legal, procurement, CloudMart billing integration)
- Action items + owners and target dates (close timeline)
- Blockers and support needed from Redwood leadership

Please review the MAP tab highlighted in the workbook and the procurement checklist before the call — key sections to look at are: "Listing responsibilities", "Metering/billing path", and "Required legal artifacts".

Initial asks:
- Nina: confirm the preferred listing channel (AWS vs AWS/CloudMart combo) and any partner onboarding docs you need from us.
- Rishi: can you draft the reseller billing flow and gap list by EOD Wednesday?
- Marissa: can you confirm who on CS will own post-listing enablement?

Attachments:
- MAP_Nimbus_Onramp_v0.3.xlsx (workbook, MAP + milestones)
- Procurement_Checklist.pdf (procurement & procurement contact points)

Thanks — I'll send an invite for Thu.

— Priyom

- Nimbus prefers AWS Marketplace as the primary listing channel but we are open to a combined AWS + CloudMart reseller approach if that makes billing simpler for our enterprise customers.
- I'll bring the Nimbus procurement owner to the meeting if needed (she's out Thu morning but can join the recording).
- Attaching our internal marketplace flow doc that shows expected lead routing and billing handoff (AWS_Marketplace_Flow.pdf).

On Wed, Nov 11, 2026 at 9:22 AM Nina Patel <nina.patel@nimbustech.com> wrote:
> Thanks Priyom — saw the workbook and appreciate the clarity.

Team — I ran a quick pass on the MAP workbook and sketched the reseller/billing flow. I attached the first pass of Reseller_Terms_Draft.docx for legal to start with. Summary of what I captured:

- Listing channel recommendation: Primary listing on AWS Marketplace public listing + CloudMart as a billing reseller via AWS Private Offer. This keeps Nimbus on AWS but routes enterprise invoices through CloudMart (recommended for customers who prefer consolidated billing).
- Key dependencies:
  - Nimbus: complete product SKU list and metering spec (Nina) — due 11/17
  - CloudMart: confirm reseller private offer process and required legal countersign (Jon) — due 11/19
  - Redwood: provide standard reseller clause + SOC2 evidence bundle for listing (Rishi) — draft to legal 11/13
  - CS enablement: Marissa to draft enablement runbook for post-listing onboarding — due 11/22

Action owners (short):
- Rishi: compile SOC2 + compliance package and send to Nimbus legal (due 11/13) [Attachment: Reseller_Terms_Draft.docx]
- Priyom: coordinate CloudMart & Nimbus touchpoint and finalize MAP owners (ongoing)
- Marissa: CS enablement owner & runbook (due 11/22)
- Nina: product SKU & metering spec (due 11/17)
- Jon: clarify CloudMart private offer process and billing timeline (due 11/19)

I'll drop the Reseller_Terms_Draft into the shared Drive and ping legal for a quick review. If anyone sees a missing dependency, flag it now.

- Rishi
Director, Commercial Ops, Redwood Inference

(Attachment: Reseller_Terms_Draft.docx)

Subject: Weekly MAP checkpoint — meeting notes & owners (summary)

Team — thanks for the quick turn this week. Below are the condensed meeting notes, current status, and confirmed owners. I included target dates so we can track against the MAP workbook.

Meeting notes (11/12)
- Decision: Proceed with AWS public listing + CloudMart as reseller via AWS Private Offer to allow consolidated billing for enterprise customers.
- Blocker: Nimbus to confirm SKU/metering details; will drive listing completion.

Confirmed action items
- Nina (Nimbus): final SKU + metering spec — due EOD 2026-11-17 — owns: product details, sample usage metrics
- Rishi (Redwood): SOC2 & compliance package + initial reseller clause draft — delivered to Nimbus legal & Redwood legal for review by 2026-11-13 (in flight)
- Jon (CloudMart): confirm Private Offer steps and expected billing cutover timeline — due 2026-11-19
- Marissa (Redwood CS): onboarding runbook + enablement checklist for marketplace customers — due 2026-11-22
- Priyom (Redwood): schedule follow-up cadence and escalate any legal procurement delays — weekly sync on Mondays

Risks / escalation path
- If Nimbus misses SKU/metering by 11/17, listing will slip 2–3 weeks; Redwood to consider a brief credit/trial offer for early enterprise customers to mitigate revenue impact. Escalation to Head of Revenue if dates slip more than 10 business days.

Next milestone
- 11/13: Redwood legal to confirm reseller clause comments (Rishi lead)
- 11/17: Nimbus sends SKU & metering (Nina)
- 11/19: CloudMart confirms Private Offer mechanics (Jon)

- MAP_Nimbus_Onramp_v0.3.xlsx
